name: @redivivus/api
description: Declarations of redivivus, the mod built into Redivivus (its modules redivivus:server, redivivus:shared and the rest, emitted from the code that runs), the sandbox's Lua library as TypeScript, LuaLS files, and the editor plugin. Mod projects map "redivivus:*" to redivivus/*.d.ts (rdvmod tsconfig writes that).
